title: Zaishen Order

__NOTOC__ [[File:Zaishen priest.jpg|right|200px]] The [[Zaishen Order]] is an intercontinental [[NPC guilds|guild]] that honors the [[Gods of Tyria|god]] [[Balthazar]]. It is led by the [[Zaishen High Council]]. Their devotion to Balthazar's rites and ceremonies dates back nearly to antiquity. Aside from hosting various tournaments and [[arena]]s, the Zaishen Order also protect [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]] from [[demon]]ic forces and guard the portals to [[the Rift]] that were created by [[Lord Odran]]. The Zaishen practice their philosophy of combat amongst themselves in [[Zaishen Challenge (outpost)|one of the Battle Isle's arenas]], while the elite of the Order defend their honor in [[Zaishen Elite (outpost)|a secret location]] that is but seldomly revealed to outsiders. ==Members== {| {{STDT}} |- style="background-color: silver;" !
